label: b47: Beyond the Rainbow (row C2), hist8 at 1M counted steps, eval every 1,000 -- paper cell (64 lanes, 64M moves) beside the local plumbing with QR-DQN N 32, btr paper cell, seed 4 of 8
notes: Batch b47: row C2, Beyond the Rainbow (Clark, Towers, Evers & Hare 2024; its released code where paper and code disagree): IQN 8/8/8 with Munchausen (alpha 0.9, tau 0.03, l0 -1, actions averaged per quantile, log-pi from the online net), no double Q, dueling 512-wide noisy streams over a residual MLP trunk (3 blocks, spectral norm inside them), PER alpha 0.2 with the code's importance exponent 0.2. btrpaper (b47a-d): SNEK_ALGO=btr at its defaults -- 64 lanes, batch 256, one update per vector step, Adam 1e-4 eps 0.005/256, clip 10, target every 500 updates, gamma 0.997, 2^20 replay, 200k prefill under the schedule, epsilon 1 -> 0.01 geometric over 2M moves then 0 from half the run; 1M counted steps = 64M moves, about the paper's 50M. btrlocal (b47e-h): the same stack with QR-DQN N 32 in place of IQN 8 on the local plumbing (1M counted steps = 4M moves). Read against b38 (IQN N 8 local) and b40e-h (M-QR-DQN local, 3M). Prediction (agent, 2026-09-23): the paper cell is the best paper cell the series has run -- above 50% perfect by 64M moves -- but no stage-B row; the local cell tracks b40e-h's first million steps (no onset yet at 1M, since b40e-h crossed 90 at 1.13-1.54M), so C2-local reads as shape only at this cap. Paper cells follow the paper wherever the game allows (plans/algoExploration/README.md, widened 2026-09-23): the paper's loss and reduction, priorities, batch-max importance weights, clipping, Adam and its eps, batch, replay, prefill, target, n-step 3, exploration and its shape, 512-wide noisy dueling streams; departures are the README's forced ones only -- rewards unclipped with the support from the return range, fc 320 as the conv encoder's analogue, hist8 as the game, the potential shaping off (the b2 preset's food 1, death -5, win +100, step 0.01 stay). Local cells run the same algorithm on b35's local DQN plumbing (fork 4, shield 0.8, PER 0.6 mean-normalised, target every 8, replay ratio 1, batch 128, lr 1e-5, eval-driven epsilon, gamma 0.99, shaping 0.1 gate 75). Paper and local share the step cap and eval every 1,000 counted steps (the user, 2026-09-23). Built and reviewed 2026-09-23 (algos/rainbow; mut_rainbow.json 33/33; smokes of both names).
